notes.title: Written Before "Lonely Trip" Releasing
notes.content:
"Lonely Trip" is my first published game. And it is completed all by myself, including design, art and program. Except for the music is composed by a schoolmate. The music is really good and in perfect harmony with the game.

I started to develop "Lonely Trip" when I was in college. At that time, I knew nothing about coding. So I went to the library everyday learning Unity and C#. When I graduated, I have finished most of the levels. I was considering publishing on app store. But somehow, I didn’t. I think mostly because I was not confident enough and I wanted to make it better.

It has been a few years. Many things happened. I once doubted about myself. I once doubted about this game. I had the thought of giving up many times. In fact, I didn’t even open the project for a long time.

Recently, I determined to finish and publish "Lonely Trip". I want this game to be played by more players. Thankfully, it is much easier to publish on Steam for an individual Chinese developer.

I know "Lonely Trip" is not perfect. But I think I have done my best. It is like a child of mine. Now, it will be published in a few days to meet players from all over the world. I feel both nervous and excited. Hope you like this game!

If you have any problems while playing the game, or any suggestions, please do not hesitate to contact me! Any feedback of yours is precious to me!

You can comment on the store page, or leave a message in community, or contact me with email. 
Email:  oneyuangames@gmail.com.
Twitter:  http://twitter.com/oneyuangames
